title: Convergence of the rescaled area integrals at a density and Lebesgue point (parent steps 7–8)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, F : ℝ^n → ℝ^P continuous, B ⊆ ℝ^n Borel, J : ℝ^n → ℝ Borel with 0 ≤ J(a) ≤ K for every a ∈ ℝ^n, m > 0 and b ∈ ℝ^n, and let L := DF(b) = fderiv ℝ F b. Assume (i) m|a − b| ≤ |F(a) − F(b)| for every a ∈ B; (ii) F is differentiable at b; (iii) m|c| ≤ |Lc| for every c ∈ ℝ^n; (iv) λ(B ∩ B̄_ρ(b))/λ(B̄_ρ(b)) → 1 as ρ → 0⁺ (quotient in [0, ∞]); (v) ⨍_{B̄_ρ(b)} |J − J(b)| dλ → 0 as ρ → 0⁺. Let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be continuous with compact support. Then ∫_{ℝ^n} 1_B(b + rc)·J(b + rc)·f(r^{-1}(F(b + rc) − F(b))) dλ(c) → J(b)·∫_{ℝ^n} f(Lc) dλ(c) as r → 0⁺. Here λ is Lebesgue measure on ℝ^n, B̄_ρ(b) is the closed ball, 1_B·J = B.indicator J, and all integrals and averages are Bochner integrals (b ∈ B is not assumed).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (J : Euclid n → ℝ) (K m : ℝ) (b : Euclid n) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), Continuous F → MeasurableSet B → Measurable J → (∀ a, 0 ≤ J a ∧ J a ≤ K) → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ B, m * ‖a - b‖ ≤ ‖F a - F b‖) → DifferentiableAt ℝ F b → (∀ c, m * ‖c‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ F b c‖) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => volume (B ∩ closedBall b ρ) / volume (closedBall b ρ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => ⨍ a in closedBall b ρ, ‖J a - J b‖ ∂volume) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ∫ c, B.indicator J (b + r • c) * f (r⁻¹ • (F (b + r • c) - F b)) ∂volume) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (J b * ∫ c, f (fderiv ℝ F b c) ∂volume))
